title: Build recovery, rollback and degraded state view
purpose: Expose recovery and rollback truth in the TUI so operators can understand interrupted or degraded AgentOS state.
scope: Render recoverable runs from RunStore and AuditJournal classification.
Render rollback-pending effects and required operator actions.
Render degraded mode causes and fallback behavior.
Render recovery command hints using typed grammar.
Separate automatic verification, rollback required and human review states.
acceptance_criteria: Recovery view states its source as run-store plus audit truth.
Rollback-pending state cannot be hidden by successful dashboard health.
Recovery commands never trigger model replay.
Degraded optional dependency state is visible but baseline operation remains possible.
failure_modes: Recovery view uses synthetic or model-derived state.
Rollback-pending effects are treated as completed.
Degraded causes are omitted from operator output.
